name: Skill Manager
description: Manage Deeting skills through npx skills ecosystem

tools.name: find_skills
tools.description: Search for skills in the npx skills ecosystem (61K+ skills from Claude, OpenClaw, Cursor, etc.)

tools.name: add_skill
tools.description: Install a skill from npx skills ecosystem and link it to Deeting's skills directory

skill_names.description: Specific skill names to install (if package contains multiple)

tools.name: check_skill_updates
tools.description: Check for available updates to installed skills

tools.name: update_skills
tools.description: Update all installed skills to their latest versions

skill_ids.description: Specific skill IDs to update (optional, defaults to all)

tools.name: inspect_skill_environment
tools.description: Check local environment for skill requirements (git, node, npx, python3)

tools.name: refresh_skill_index
tools.description: Refresh Deeting's skill index after manual changes to skills directory

tools.name: uninstall_skill
tools.description: Remove an installed skill from Deeting

skill_id.description: ID of the skill to uninstall
